title: Six-phase fault classification benchmark: solver, feature layer and classifier code
description:
Code accompanying the six-phase transmission-line 178-class fault classification study: a purpose-built six-phase electromagnetic-transient solver, the line-parameter and case-generator scripts, the sequence-modal feature layer of Algorithm 1, and the training, attribution and plotting scripts.

All data in the study were generated by simulation, deterministically from the master seed 20260829; no external or third-party data set was used. reproduce.sh regenerates the complete case set from that seed — the 178-class taxonomy, the operating-point table of all 45,568 cases, the 255-element feature matrix with its labels, the scenario-level partition and the representative relay-rate voltage and current records — and reproduces every table and figure in the paper. SHA-256 checksums of the outputs are listed in the release so a reproduction can be checked without contacting the authors.
